title: Gamma ray within its plausible range
description: Every Gamma Ray sample lies from minimum to maximum, both included. A curve is Gamma Ray when its upper-cased mnemonic is in the Gamma Ray quantity's suggest_from mnemonics and its unit, as written, is in that quantity's units (quantities.json); all such curves are checked. A sample equal to the header NULL, or missing, is not a value. A data row fails once; its example is the first failing sample in ~Curve order. No Gamma Ray curve: not applicable (no-column).

parameters.name: minimum
parameters.source: API units are counted against the University of Houston calibration pit of 200 API units (Kansas Geological Survey, Geological Log Analysis, The Gamma Ray Log); a reading below zero is not a measurement.

parameters.name: maximum
parameters.source: Kansas Geological Survey, Geological Log Analysis, The Gamma Ray Log: about 3700 API units is the most expected for the black shale with the most elevated uranium content; rounded up to 4000.

words.template: {count} rows have a gamma ray outside {minimum} to {maximum}, the first at {first}.
